name: System integration design
description: For designing a system made of hardware and software parts, without writing code. An architect draws the system architecture diagram, a hardware scout searches the internet for parts that fit, and an architecture reviewer checks that everything works together, so you choose with evidence.

steps.name: System architect
steps.purpose: Turns the requirement into a system architecture: the blocks, what each does, and how they connect.
produces: .devcrew/SYSTEM.md: blocks, requirements per block, data, power and safety paths, open questions

steps.name: Hardware scout
steps.purpose: Searches the internet for hardware that fits each block and lays out the options so you can choose.
produces: .devcrew/hardware/options.md: two to four sourced part options per block, with a recommendation
.devcrew/system.json: the recommended part on each block

steps.name: Architecture reviewer
steps.purpose: Checks that the parts and the design fit together before you commit to them.
produces: .devcrew/arch-review.md: a verdict and architecture findings by severity
